MAC RELEASE

Mac 1.5.18 · build 34

Reuse icon rendering across repeated appearance changes and select sidebar rows across their full padded area.

Previous Mac release2026-10-19
Mac DMGMac ZIP

macOS 13 or later · Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel

HighlightsImprovementsSupport and limitsDownloads

Highlights

Mac 1.5.18 reuses the icon render cache across repeated appearance changes. Each sidebar row is clickable across its full padded area, including the space around its text and icon.

The menu bar departure visibility option introduced in 1.5.17 remains supported.

On Mac, Settings → General → Show expected departure in menu bar is on by default. When on, it shows Leave 18:00 · 91 min left; when off, it shows only 91 min left. Changes apply immediately and the choice survives restart.

At or after expected departure, leaving this option on shows only the expected departure time. Turning it off shows Ready to leave. Waiting for arrival, Day off today and Leave day labels stay unchanged.

Improvements

  • Reuses the icon render cache across repeated appearance changes.
  • Makes each sidebar row clickable across its full padded area.
  • Keeps the departure visibility option from 1.5.17 and existing records and preferences.

Support and limits

macOS 13 or later; Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel. The icon rendering and sidebar click-area fixes apply to Mac. The latest public Windows release remains 1.5.13 and is unchanged.

The app identifier, record location, existing menu bar time display and plugin preferences stay the same.

Uses a fixed self-signed certificate and Sparkle update signatures. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not applied. This release preparation and publication does not replace the installed app or accept permissions on your behalf. Other Macs, physical Intel hardware and actual unlock/reboot login remain separate validation scopes.

Downloads

Open the DMG and move happylulu to Applications, or extract the ZIP and move the app. Quit the existing app before replacing it.
